data.name: Abideen
data.long_meaning: One who abides by the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). This name is derived from the Arabic root 'abd' which means 'servant' or 'worshiper'. Abideen is a name that evokes a sense of spiritual devotion, obedience, and submission to Allah.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes dedication and commitment to the path of Allah.
data.numerology_meaning: Those with the life path number 3 are creative, artistic, and sociable. They thrive in the arts and enjoy being around people.
